-- Confined read of notes/ for untrusted request paths.

-- True when path names a location inside notes: relative, no leading slash,
-- and never climbing above its starting directory.
is_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  ex is_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("../x") == False
  ex is_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  for c in path.chars()
    if c == "\\"
      return False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for p in parts
    if p == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      if p != "." and p != ""
        depth += 1
  True

-- Text of notes/path, or "" when the path leaves notes or the file cannot be read.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_inside(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("../x") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  if is_inside(path) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(path) else ""

test_is_inside() =
  assert is_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  assert is_inside("sub/../../x") == False
